The comment is excluded and the import remains counted. All five units count separately in each Pi bundle even though the names are generic compatibility glue.
diagnostic_meaning.DNA_recover: Both original DNA.apply bodies have the identical recover val source interval90..689. benchmark_meaning.mandelbrot: Pixel iteration, early return, packed byte lanes, actor construction/result ordering and output remain. Existing scalar final selection composes as one value; no iteration body is removed.
benchmark_meaning.fasta: Probability-entry pushes, cumulative mutation, long ALU data literal, RNG, buffering and output phases are retained. The long literal remains one written data declaration; no size-based discount or expansion is added.

benchmark_meaning.binarytrees: Node fields, constructor branches, recursive check, actor iteration, stretch/long roots and worker joins are counted. The pure recursive check remains the existing expression-member composition; the constructor/body work remains independent. Compiler storage optimization does not change source LOC.
benchmark_meaning.nbody: Every written body field/constant, five constructors, pair interactions, integration, momentum offset, energy and actor/output methods remain. Multi-line cascade argument wrapping is structural; each independent written call/action remains under the unchanged policy.
benchmark_meaning.fannkuchredux: Permutation initialization/rotation, flips/swaps, rank/checksum/max, worker scheduling and result/output remain. Optimized reusable work-array declaration/copy loop is counted; no allocation or callback source is discounted.
